title: 高盛称市场颠簸：但方向仍正面，盈利支撑能否持续？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: In the beginning of the earning season or through the bulk of it, we talked about this really strong earning number, 30% growth that have been supporting this equity market. Now that the season is over,
segments.zh: 财报季初期或大部分时间里，我们都在讨论强劲的盈利增长，30%的增速支撑了市场。现在财报季结束，

segments.en: are we just going to have risk markets being bullied around by yields today? It's a good story, but other days it's been pressure from higher yields. Yeah, I think we're going to continue to be
segments.zh: 风险市场是否会被收益率左右？这是个好故事，但其他时候也面临收益率上升的压力。是的，我认为我们将继续

segments.en: in this kind of ping pong of volatility, especially under the hood stock level volatility and stock level dispersions. Actually, though, why does we've seen in two decades? So, I think we're
segments.zh: 处于这种波动拉锯中，尤其是个股层面的波动和分化。实际上，这是二十年来罕见的。所以我认为

segments.en: going to say bumpy, but I think that the direction of travel for the equity market is quite constructive. We talk about this a lot. We always come back to the earning story. You mentioned
segments.zh: 市场会颠簸，但方向是建设性的。我们经常讨论盈利故事。你提到

segments.en: some good numbers, but it's not just the magnitude. It's the breadth of earning strengths by sector, by region, by market cap. And importantly, the revisions going up in the visibility on the durability
segments.zh: 一些好数字，但不仅是幅度，还有盈利强势的广度，按行业、地区、市值来看。重要的是，修正上调，盈利持久性的可见度

segments.en: of that. And as we start to continue to see some of this ROI coming from whether it's the hyperscalers, even early stages coming through other sectors like consumer and healthcare, that's going to be
segments.zh: 随着我们看到来自超大规模企业甚至消费和医疗等行业的早期回报，这将形成

segments.en: a positive corporate feedback loop, so they'll continue to invest. That will drive good earnings.
segments.zh: 积极的企业反馈循环，它们将继续**，推动良好盈利。

segments.en: And I think that'll support the equity market going forward. So, the stock market definitely has been resilient. Do you think that they're just telling investors or yields that we don't care
segments.zh: 这将支撑未来市场。市场确实表现出韧性。你认为它们是在告诉市场参与者或收益率我们不在乎

segments.en: what level they are in? We have good earnings. There's AI. Or do you think investors are maybe underpricing that risk? No, I think the earnings have clearly been the armor. That's why we've
segments.zh: 它们的水平吗？我们有良好盈利，还有AI。或者你认为市场参与者低估了风险？不，我认为盈利显然是盔甲，这就是为什么我们

segments.en: been able to tolerate these yields. And I mean, but the bad news, of course, is that as bond yields go up, that does pressure evaluations. But valuations have absolutely not been driving this market.
segments.zh: 能够容忍这些收益率。但坏消息是，债券收益率上升确实给估值带来压力。但估值绝对没有驱动这个市场。
